messages.subject: Not happy
messages.text: I didn’t receive my entire order. I didn’t receive any of the seeds. Very disappointing after waiting for them and nothing. Money and time wasted

messages.subject: Re: Not happy
messages.text:
Hi Marlaina,

I'm genuinely sorry. Your seeds should have been sorted out long ago, and coming back to you this late on top of a missing order is not acceptable. This isn't how we run things, and we'll do better here.

Here's what happens now: I'm pulling your original order to confirm which seed varieties were missing, and I'll get a replacement package out to you. If any of the exact varieties you ordered happen to be out of stock, I'll swap in the closest available species and let you know before it ships.

One thing I want to confirm first: is your shipping address still the one on your original order? Once that's set, the seeds go out and I'll make sure they actually reach you this time.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
